The '''Carlania system''' was located in the [[Interior Region]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was connected via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Arabanth system/Legends|Arabanth]] and [[Ediorung system/Legends|Ediorung systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Carlania [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the origin point of [[Carlanian volcanic pipe]]s.<ref name="Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Carlanian volcanic pipe]]s|system=Carlania [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Carlania system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
